title: Credit Card Four-Key USB Macro Pad

via.rationale: Whole-board density-driven 0.50/0.30 mm through-via geometry for this compact 0.5 mm-pitch design. The 0.10 mm annular ring meets the selected two-layer JLC capability and is used consistently by every autorouted via and net class.

GND.rationale: Two-layer return plane for USB power, display, keys, and analog audio.

escape.rationale: J1 is a 0.5 mm-pitch FPC connector and C3/C5 have GND pads inside narrow routed channels. These endpoints use short 0.30 mm-wide cross-layer GND escapes at the declared 0.15 mm manufacturing clearance to top-layer landing pads, with production 0.5/0.3 mm vias owned by the traces.

VBUS.rationale: USB 5 V from the XIAO module and LCD backlight supply.

V3V3.rationale: The router is net-wide and J1 pin 7 is only 0.30 mm wide, so V3V3 is deliberately qualified at 0.30 mm with 0.15 mm clearance. The complete rail carries less than 200 mA on 1 oz copper over approximately 70 mm, which is acceptable for this 3.3 V low-power load.

LCD_MOSI.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI data trace. The 0.25/0.15 mm rule is a deliberate 0.5 mm-pitch J1 escape rule, with no controlled-impedance requirement.

LCD_SCK.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI clock. The 0.25/0.15 mm rule is required at 0.5 mm-pitch J1; keep it away from the microphone block and over continuous ground.

LCD_RESET_N.rationale: Hardware RC reset node; 0.25/0.15 mm is deliberately used for the 0.5 mm-pitch J1 escape.

LCD_LEDA.rationale: The router is net-wide and J1 pin 1 is only 0.30 mm wide. LCD_LEDA is therefore deliberately qualified at 0.30 mm with 0.15 mm clearance; its 27 ohm resistor limits current below 120 mA over the approximately 16 mm 1 oz route.

MIC_RAW.rationale: ZTS6216 analog output before AC coupling.

MIC_AC.rationale: AC-coupled microphone signal biased at VBIAS.

VBIAS.rationale: Filtered 1.65 V virtual ground for the preamplifier.

MIC_FB.rationale: TLV9061 feedback node; minimize loop area.

MIC_AMP.rationale: Amplified microphone signal before anti-alias resistor.

MIC_ADC.rationale: Filtered ADC input to XIAO D8.

keepouts.name: U1_ANTENNA_COPPER_KEEPOUT
keepouts.rationale: Keep carrier copper clear beneath the XIAO ESP32S3 antenna end.

allowedOverlaps.rationale: TP_GND_J1_ESCAPE is a non-assembled top-layer GND landing for the reviewed cross-layer escape from J1 pin 2; any body-envelope overlap is intentional and does not overlap same-layer supplier pads.
